_doc: BeTenshi service commands. docker = container name. cmd+args+cwd = spawn a process. skip = externally managed.
_models-doc: Model weights live on D: (see HF_HOME below), NOT the default C:\Users\Admin\.cache\huggingface. HF_HOME is set per-service rather than relied upon from the user environment: the manager runs as a scheduled task and inherits its environment at launch, so a user-level variable set afterwards would not reach spawned services until a re-login — they would silently fall back to the empty default path and re-download every model. Every service that loads Hugging Face weights must carry it.

voice._doc: Its OWN interpreter, unlike every other Python service here. chatterbox-tts pins torch==2.6.0, which has no Blackwell kernels and cannot run on the 5090; the venv is built with --system-site-packages so it inherits the working torch 2.11.0+cu128. Installing it into Python312 would have downgraded transformers and numpy under the running Whisper and Kokoro services.

laya._doc: Its OWN venv, built with --system-site-packages so it inherits the Blackwell-capable torch 2.11.0+cu128; laya itself is pure Python and pins nothing older. server.py wraps laya's Router behind POST /decide and binds loopback only: laya's bundled laya-serve binds 0.0.0.0 with no auth by default. USE_TF=0 per laya's README (TensorFlow's abseil can deadlock model construction). HF_HUB_OFFLINE: the three checkpoints are already on D:, so a start never waits on the hub. LAYA_DEVICE=cpu ON PURPOSE: on the GPU it answers in ~30-50 ms but holds ~6 GB of a card five explorations were contending for; on CPU it answers in ~150-300 ms, still several times faster than any LLM call, with no VRAM at all (measured in docs/decision-model-experiment-2026-09-27.md). For a bulk run set LAYA_DEVICE=cuda, and change local-laya's footprint in model-meta.json to match.

music._doc: ACE-Step 1.5, from its OWN venv like voice, for the same reason: ACE-Step pins torch 2.7.1 and transformers<4.58, and the shared Python312 has transformers 5.4 under Whisper and Kokoro. The venv inherits torch 2.11+cu128 via --system-site-packages; ACE-Step is an editable --no-deps install of the pinned clone at AI\acestep. Weights on D: via ACESTEP_CHECKPOINTS_DIR. PYTHONIOENCODING because ACE-Step logs emoji, which crash a cp1252 stdout the manager captures. Loopback-only: nothing outside this box should reach it. The MUSIC_* env is the configuration that fits beside quote-forge's resident vllm-small (19 GB): XL DiT in int8, VAE/text encoder and the 1.7B planner offloaded between phases — +4.8 GB resident, +8.8 GB peak, measured (docs/music-model-experiment-2026-09-27.md). With the card to itself, drop MUSIC_QUANT/MUSIC_OFFLOAD* and use acestep-5Hz-lm-4B.

_3d-doc: The 3D Lab's two mesh services, both localOnly like the AI Router. trellis is trellis.cpp's own native server (TRELLIS.2 + Pixal3D share one GGUF directory on D:; each request picks with a `model` field). It loads and frees each stage per request, so between meshes it holds only its CUDA context and ggml pool (1.3 GB measured). TripoSR runs from its own venv (torch inherited via --system-site-packages).
_ollama-doc: Second LLM runtime beside vLLM, for models vLLM 0.17.1 cannot load (Gemma 4 needs vLLM >= 0.19) and for on-demand vision. Normally already running from the Ollama tray app, which is fine: the manager adopts the external process and reports it as externally owned. OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE is short on purpose - one 31B model is ~20 GB of a 32 GB card, so an idle model left resident is what blocks the next image generation. OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 for the same reason: two of these do not coexist.

process-engine._doc: Operaton, the process lab's BPMN/DMN engine. The manager only docker-starts an existing container: create it once with `docker compose up -d` in C:\Users\Admin\Code\AI\process-lab (compose also chowns the H2 volume for the image's uid 1000).

searxng._doc: Free web search for local models (the Video Forge's search tool). The manager only docker-starts an existing container; it was created once with: docker run -d --name searxng --restart unless-stopped -p 127.0.0.1:8888:8080 -e SEARXNG_SECRET=<random hex> -e SEARXNG_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8888/ -v C:/Users/Admin/Code/AI/searxng:/etc/searxng searxng/searxng:latest. Loopback-only: never publish it on 0.0.0.0.

process-lab._doc: The process lab's workers, simulator and API (Node 24, no npm dependencies). WHEN_LOCAL_UNAVAILABLE=cloud: when the coordinator will not give the GPU, or another session holds logs/gpu-claim.txt, an AI step runs on the cloud model instead of waiting, and the case record says so with the cost. Set it to 'fail' to make cases wait for the local model instead.

_ai-router-doc: LiteLLM proxy. --host 127.0.0.1 is a HARD requirement: this gateway must never be reachable off-box. Cloud API keys come from the environment (OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); a missing key leaves that model listed but reporting 'no key configured'.
